text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the camp lodge getting some<n>work done
while the racers are out on<n>break.

I see you're hard at work, Trainer.<n>Are those all
adjustments to my<n>regimen?
choice_data_list:
Yep. It's important to make the best out of the
season.

Yep. It's important to make the best out of the
season.

text_block_list.text: Hehe... I appreciate your<n>consideration.

By the way, are you staying<n>hydrated? Would you
like a glass of<n>sweetened barley tea?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I know what you're thinking: sugar,<n>in barley tea?
Surprising, I know... but<n>it works well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Please, have some, and we can relax<n>for—
Relax?! Nuh-uh!
Not when you and I have a score to<n>settle, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh... El... What has gotten into you all<n>of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The power of el sol! The crashin'<n>waves onto la
playa! They call to me!

In other words, your excitement has<n>bubbled over,
and you want me to<n>help you burn off the excess
energy?
That's one way to put it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Grass! A fight! A<n>competition! I need
some kinda<n>challenge!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... But this is so sudden...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's smile seems forced,<n>but this is a
chance to face a rival<n>who will be racing against her
in the<n>Japan Cup.

She might learn something useful.<n>With that in
mind...
choice_data_list: How about a game of beach flags?
How about a battle of endurance?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So, a race to grab a flag stuck in the<n>sand?

A proper activity for some beach-time<n>fun! Let's do
it! Ándale! Ándale!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Be reasonable, El. You can't just up<n>and start—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh? Chickenin' out, Grass?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, you always were one of them<n>"take it slow"
types. Can't blame ya<n>for turnin' tail when the
goin' gets<n>tough!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Talk all you want. Your cheap little<n>taunts won't be
getting under my<n>skin.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll humor you for one round, and one<n>round only.
So I hope that makes you<n>happy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so, a one-off beach flag match<n>gets underway.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!
Whaaa?! Q-qué rápida!
Hehe... Have I ever told you?

I've dabbled in the sword-drawing art<n>of iaido, so I
have a bit of confidence<n>in my reaction time. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, due to El Condor Pasa's<n>constant
requests for a rematch,<n>Grass Wonder ends up
taking her on<n>several more times with a confident
smile.

So... if I've understood you correctly,<n>there's a
challenge to eat piping hot<n>food with the AC off?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Trainer, that's a death<n>wish.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I guess you don't know. Grass might<n>not look it,
but she hates the heat!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Like right before bed when it's super<n>humid and
hot, sometimes her<n>tummy—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I-is it just me, or did it<n>suddenly get kinda
chilly?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Thank you for the<n>wonderful suggestion,
Trainer.

However, we are Umamusume. We<n>settle things
with our legs. Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Why don't we have a race, El? ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It'll help you work off aaaall that<n>excess energy.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All in all, getting to run alongside El<n>Condor Pasa
seems to have been a<n>fruitful experience for Grass
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Later that night, I return to the beach<n>to find...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nghh... I went a bit overboard this<n>afternoon... I'm
gonna be sore<n>tomorrow.
choice_data_list: You did great, El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, Grass's trainer! Buenas noches.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gracias for the suggestion earlier! It<n>was the
release I really needed!
But I think I ran my tank too dry...
choice_data_list: You and Grass seem like good friends.
You and Grass seem like good friends.

text_block_list.text: Haha! Do we?
I tell ya, though. Back when we first<n>met...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I thought she was a snooze fest 'n a<n>half!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It was durin' the entrance exam for<n>Tracen
Academy.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
First we all had a once-over to gauge<n>our potential.
Then it was time to<n>race...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But me? I was bored outta my mind.

(Hmmm... I know it's just the<n>entrance exam, but I
thought Tracen<n>Academy'd be more, I dunno,
challengin'?)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(Like, more passion, more flair. More<n>KA-BOOM!
...That's what I'm after.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Might you be El Condor<n>Pasa, by any
chance?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué? Ah, yep! That's me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You and I have been assigned to the<n>same racing
block. My name is Grass<n>Wonder.

Even chance meetings are<n>predetermined. May we
both have a<n>fruitful race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll see you on the track.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, ditto...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And that was all! Can ya believe it?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We were right before a race! A big<n>one, with our
careers on the line!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But she's all lackadaisy 'n smilin'.<n>Where's the
fire? Where's the<n>drive?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a letdown. Why do I gotta<n>run with this
snooze fest, ya know?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But then...
Fly! Soar! INTO THE SKYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look how long her stride is! She<n>did crazy
good on the other tests too,<n>but this—this is on a
whole 'nother<n>level!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: She's not the only one.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you paying attention in the<n>fitness test?
The one who really put<n>us all to shame was...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I could tell she was different.

Her form, her aura, her guts! Grass<n>was nothin'
like the rest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Durin' the race, I'd get the lead,<n>she'd take it, then
me again, back<n>and forth. Finally endin' in a tie.

It was my first taste of it, the burnin'<n>desire
beneath that mellow grin.
I was shakin' in my cleats.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's when I knew!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That if I wanna prove myself the<n>world's strongest
racer, I've gotta<n>beat Grass Wonder at her best.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take her down head-on<n>when she's
givin' it her all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And then everyone'll see that no<n>one's faster than
the one, the only...<n>El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can see the determination burning in<n>El Condor
Pasa's eyes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I swear I'll have those gentle blueeyes boiling as she watches me teardown the turf!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oops! I said a little too much there!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'll fill ya in later, after the startin'<n>gate opens!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Adiós... 'Til the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, El Condor Pasa runs<n>like the wind
into the night.
